# saferm\-notify

```go
import "github.com/shdeen/saferm/cmd/saferm-notify"
```

Command saferm\-notify runs SafeRM Notify, the optional background program that shows notifications for actions awaiting the user's approval.

<a name="Service"></a>
## type Service

Service shows a notification for each pending action that is pushed to SafeRM Notify, and carries out the response chosen on that notification.

    // contains filtered or unexported fields

<a name="Service.ServiceShutdown"></a>
### func \(\*Service\) ServiceShutdown

```go
func (service *Service) ServiceShutdown() error
```

ServiceShutdown closes the listener and waits for the receiving goroutine to exit.

<a name="Service.ServiceStartup"></a>
### func \(\*Service\) ServiceStartup

```go
func (service *Service) ServiceStartup(ctx context.Context, _ application.ServiceOptions) error
```

ServiceStartup prepares SafeRM Notify when the application starts:

- registers the response handler and the notification category for reviews
- requests permission to show notifications
- opens the listener through notify.Listen and starts receiving from it

It returns an error only when the home directory cannot be determined. It logs any other failure and returns nil; a failure to register the category or to open the listener also ends the preparation there.
